verdicts.reason: A reads left to right with a dominant 'Sunset Sessions' headline, but the italic tagline is crammed into a narrow column at illegible size (7 ragged lines). The RSVP CTA is shrunk to badge size inside a 2x2 pill grid, so it is buried. The legal text is tiny, the broken-asset placeholder collides with the 'Reserve a spot' line, and the can illustration is lost. B is fragmented: the date sits in the middle while its time is stranded at the far right above the legal text. The broken-asset placeholder overlaps 'Saturday 21 June', and the headline floats top-centre without dominating. RSVP is again just another badge, and the can, logo and 'Solstice presents' are scattered with no grid, so the reading order is jumbled.
